svg.title: Same fraction, different denominator
svg.desc: Four panels use stipulated 100-cell samples: A has 10 T cells among 20 immune cells, B has 30 among 60. Both immune-subset fractions are 50 percent, while whole-sample T-cell fractions are 10 and 30 percent. A separate pooled RNA and reference-model scene labels RNA contribution as different evidence from these supplied cell counts.
svg.text: Fictional teaching scene; no clinical cutoff
1 Supplied cell counts, not model output
RNA share ≠ cell share. References can
miss populations or fit similar mixtures.
